title: A screened session killed at its time limit keeps its spent cost
body:
S7 screen rows t-1182p41 and t-1mx3apz have cost 0 and no session result line: runClaude SIGKILLs the session group at the time limit, so no total_cost_usd is printed and the row records cost 0 though the session spent tokens. Cost per resolved task is co-primary in S8 (ADR 0021).
Files: evals/replay/live.ts, test/evals/screening-units.test.ts
Outcome: a timed-out session row carries a cost read from the session transcript usage, or is marked unknown and never 0; a test with a fake claude that sleeps past the limit passes (exit 0).
Proof: node --test on the replay live test exits 0 with the timed-out-session cost test.
